You're eligible to return it. A pot is a non-living item, so it can be returned within 30 days of delivery if it's unused and in its original packaging, and you're at day 12.

As a Leafy Plus member, your change-of-mind return is free, so the $6.95 fee doesn't apply. Start the return from "My Orders" and a prepaid label will be emailed to you. Drop the parcel off within 7 days, because the label expires after that. Your refund goes to your original payment method within 5 business days of the parcel reaching our warehouse. Original shipping isn't refunded, since this isn't a return caused by our error.

There are no direct exchanges, so if you'd like a different colour, you'd place a new order for it.
